items.summary: Rescan with the fixed scan_nvidia: third_party/cubvh/LICENSE_NVIDIA is the NVIDIA Source Code License for instant neural graphics primitives (non-commercial), vendored via cubvh. Needs the same ruling as the cubvh project's deferred item cubvh-nvidia-proprietary-rescan. POLICY (2026-08-24): follows cubvh -- upstream to be asked what LICENSE_NVIDIA covers; do not delete the licence file. UPSTREAM ANSWER via cubvh (2026-08-26): cubvh's author confirmed instant-ngp-derived code in src/bvh.cu, triangle.cuh, bounding_box.cuh (all vendored here via third_party/cubvh and compiled on AMD). CuMesh's PR #36 is open while this stands; posture is the licensing review's call.
